interpretation: The public SPQLIOS API exposes one input/output buffer per call.
No ready batch reverse-FFT API is available for a low-risk C-level optimization.
The existing multi-row wrapper still calls `ifft` once per row, matching Stage289/290 neutral outcomes.
The AVX512 assembly entry takes one real-data pointer; batching would be a backend ABI/assembly project.
Digit materialization is local to this project and can be specialized without changing SPQLIOS ABI.
